async def act(page):
    # Click on the Bestsellers link under the Reports menu to navigate to the detailed bestsellers report
    # Use filtering to navigate the nested menu structure correctly
    reports_menu = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name="Reports").get_by_role("menu")
    # Get the third menu under Reports (which contains product-related reports)
    product_reports_menu = reports_menu.get_by_role("menu").nth(2)  # Index 2 for third menu (0-based)
    # Get the second menu under that (which contains Bestsellers link)
    bestsellers_menu = product_reports_menu.get_by_role("menu").nth(1)  # Index 1 for second menu
    bestsellers_link = bestsellers_menu.get_by_role("link", name="Bestsellers")
    await bestsellers_link.click()
    # Wait for page load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
